capabilities: Capture notes from a home panel
Archive entries into monthly, weekly, or yearly Markdown files
Group entries by date and timestamp
Show recent notes with count badges
Jump to an entry's source line
extras: Chinese-language interface and README; mobile layout support; changing the storage folder does not migrate existing archive files.
problem: Obsidian lacks a simple home panel for quickly recording fleeting ideas and automatically filing them into date-grouped periodic Markdown archives.
summary: Home-panel capture tool that saves fleeting notes into monthly, weekly, or yearly Markdown archives grouped by date.
